title: MonaCode G6-R Task Evidence Record Schema
description: Closed contract for the evidence JSON record written to a task's staged evidence path. The record grows across the lifecycle: it begins as `running` containing only the workspace token SHA-256 (published by beginTaskEvidence), accumulates canonical command/acquisition/assertion attempts as the task advances, and is finalized as `passed` by finalizeTaskEvidence. The passed record carries the product commit and selector mode `external-git` but MUST NOT embed its own blob hash (passedSha256) or its evidence commit ID. additionalProperties: false at every layer.

tokenSha256.description: SHA-256 of the controller-generated 32-byte workspace token; the sole field in the initial running record.

baseCommit.description: The preflight base commit recorded at begin; must remain HEAD until product commit.

executorHash.description: Selected command-executor module hash; absence fails closed.

sourceContract.description: Selected source-acquisition contract identity; absence fails closed.

policy.description: The MutationPolicy the observed mutations were bounded by.

productCommit.description: Present in the passed record after commit-task; never the evidence commit ID.

selectorMode.description: Present in the passed record; the evidence commit is selected via external-git first-parent enumeration, never embedded.

completionAssertions.description: Present in the passed record; the task's completion assertion IDs.

verifiedAssertions.description: Present in the passed record; must equal the task evidenceCommit.verifiedAssertions.

fileHashes.description: The controller-recorded sha256 of each product-boundary file after command execution. Required (non-empty) in a passed record for a task with product-boundary mutations; the lib validates structure + boundary membership (the hash-VALUE comparison is the controller's runtime job).

path.description: Repo-relative path (no leading slash); the lib additionally rejects leading ./ and any .. segment.
